{{Top|leg}}
An '''emergency siren''' was a noise-making system that produced a penetrating warning sound. Such devices were installed on many facilities and could be activated to give the order to evacuate the premises.<ref name="DR">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Dark Rival]]''</ref> During the height of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], an emergency siren was used at the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to draw attention to the presence of an intruder in the security perimeter.<ref name="VQ2">[[Vader's Quest 2|''Vader's Quest'' 2]]</ref>

Many [[Starship/Legends|starships]] were also equipped with such sirens, including the [[Hammerhead-class cruiser|''Hammerhead''-class cruisers]] that served with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|Navy]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]]<ref name="kotor">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref> and the modern-day [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvettes]]. In these cases, sirens were used to indicate damage and other dangerous situation such as entering combat.<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>
